Description: The Danish Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) is preparing the procurement of a comprehensive sensor and payload package for a Strategic Infrastructure Surveillance Vessel. The conversion will include integration of advanced surveillance, and subsea capabilities. Non-participation will not affect eligibility in any future procurement.
